question: Does the exact measured-total film MTF commute with the fixed nonlinear U2.2 sensitometry response closely enough to identify one exposure-, developed-density- or scan-transmittance-domain placement from current evidence?

source_boundary.manufacturer_statement: The MTF graph measures film visual sharpness while sensitometric curves separately determine density change for a change in log exposure.

arms.exposure_domain: measured-total PSF on linear layer exposure, then fixed sensitometry, then density-to-transmittance
arms.developed_density_domain: fixed sensitometry, then measured-total PSF on developed optical density, then density-to-transmittance
arms.scan_transmittance_domain: fixed sensitometry, then density-to-transmittance, then measured-total PSF on transmittance, then transmittance-to-density

branch_rule.material_noncommutation: Mark exact measured-total placement unidentified and open one bounded placement-uncertainty envelope; do not promote any arm as physical truth.
branch_rule.immaterial_noncommutation: Retain the developed-density arm only as the simplest film-inspired numerical realization, still without a physical or calibrated claim.
branch_rule.numerical_or_parent_failure: Close measured-total placement and retain P5L as reference evidence only.

forbidden: fit or tune the sensitometry curve, MTF kernel, probe amplitudes or gates after viewing the result
infer forward scatter, adjacency, dye diffusion, exposure, process or scanner causality from total MTF
select an arm using photographic appearance, AO6 output or preference
compose the measured-total operator with the replaced generic film spatial stages
fold scanner MTF or creative bloom into the film MTF
claim calibrated stock, roll, process, scanner or product response
claim_ceiling: Synthetic nonlinear-domain sensitivity of one manufacturer total-film MTF realization under the uncalibrated U2.2 sensitometry primitive; not identified physical placement, stock calibration, photographic value or product promotion.
